headline: Brief v2.1.4-beta — Stay, Watch & Verify Engine (5 Min – 4 Hours Endurance), Wholesome 👀🍿 Watching Cursor & Real Final Verification Across All 4 Models
bullets: Stay, Watch & Verify Engine (5 Min Ready → 4 Hours Max): Brief never quits early while a terminal, installer, OS flasher/validator, AI video generator, download, or another AI agent is still loading — it stays patiently, monitors progress without burning extra tokens, and catches errors, denials, or permission prompts immediately.

Wholesome Eye + Snack Watching Cursor (Windows, Linux & Android): While waiting for long processes in Live Visible or Background mode, Brief shows cute rotating watching cursor labels (👀🍿 / 👀🍕 / 👀☕ / 👀🍪) with live elapsed timers right beside the cursor and in the status bar.

End-to-End Final Verification Across All 4 LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude & OpenRouter): After a terminal finishes, a video renders, or an OS image completes flashing & validating, Brief checks exit codes, generated outputs, and target drives/SD cards before reporting success.

Full Multi-Platform Endurance: Auto-compacts long multi-hour histories cleanly, holds Android partial WakeLock during long watches on Honor MagicOS, Samsung & Pixel, and works seamlessly in Background and Live Visible modes.
